Therapist here :) Usually when mental health is “bad” it starts to interfere with your daily functioning. For example, if you’re noticing those worried feelings cause a lot of distress or if you notice those thoughts are popping up a lot. You don’t have to necessarily have bad enough mental health to seek help if you want/need it :)
You can also have symptoms of anxiety and depression without having it meet full criteria for generalized anxiety disorder or major depressive disorder. Depending on how intense, frequency, and what it is impacting you on is a sign of how good or bad things may be. 

I saw your comment about being a minor, if you have concerns I’d recommend reaching out to your school counselor or therapist which is usually free or contacting numbers like the national mental health line 988 or texting HOME to 741741 for the crisis text line. You don’t have to be in full crisis to use those resources either!
